lines: In his old age, Ibrahim stood in the valley that had once been empty, and he made a dua that Muslims still recite today.
"My Lord, make this city secure, and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols."
Praise be to Allah, who gave me in my old age Ismail and Ishaq. Indeed, my Lord hears every prayer.
"My Lord, make me one who establishes prayer, and from my descendants too. Our Lord, and accept my dua."
"Our Lord, forgive me, and my parents, and the believers, on the Day the account is established."
Many of us say this dua in every prayer, at the end of our salah. The words of Ibrahim, still on our tongues, thousands of years later.
